findings.issue: Common noun rendered as the untranslated form «Beca»; in current Spanish that word means a scholarship, which the token does not license.
«pasante» can calque the singular qal active participle, but in current Latin American Spanish it commonly means an intern; the token only licenses one who passes or crosses.
The additive cardinals and their conjunctions are smoothed into one Spanish numeral; the value 603550 is unchanged.

notes: Articles, construct «de», singular «año», and the count 603550 match the tokens.
